thread:
maya: Morning — quick async standup for the v2 rollout prep. TL;DR: need a couple PR reviews + confirm rollout checklist.

samir: Yesterday I finished the A/B traffic harness and smoke tests. No blockers from infra side.

anika: PR #482 is ready for review, just needs perf sign-off. Ping @liam for numbers. Also left a comment on the spec around error UI.

liam: will review in ~2h. Perf looks okay on staging — p50 ~85ms, p95 ~210ms at current load. Saw a memory spike in long-lived sessions, leaving a note.

dev-bot: CI: all checks passed on branch `release/v2-routing`.

deploy-bot: Canary started on cluster-us-west (10% traffic). Watching for errors.

eva: Blocker: need product sign-off on failure UX flows (doc linked: https://confluence/redwood/v2-failure-ux). Two open questions about fallback copy and telemetry.

maya: Added inline comments on the doc. @eva can you resolve the two open items by EOD? Also: prioritization question — do we ship with the current minimal fallback copy and iterate, or hold for the UX polish?

anika: My recommendation: ship now, follow up with polish. The UX changes are low-risk and non-blocking for SLA. We should not delay the rollout.

samir: Agree. Main priorities: keep SLA, alerting, and a tested rollback path. I added a simple rollback snippet to the runbook:

```
# rollback-policy
if error_rate > 0.02:
  rollout: revert 50%
  notify: #oncall
  create_incident: true
```

maya: OK +1 to that. @oncall can you confirm alerting thresholds match?

oncall: Confirmed — alerting set: error_rate > 1.5% (warn), > 2% (critical). Dashboards wired to pager. I'll watch the canary window.

maya: Thanks. Quick logistics: who can own review rotation for next week? we need someone to cover the post-launch hotfixes.

liam: I can take Mon/Wed.
anika: I’ll take Thu.
samir: I can do Tue/Fri.

maya: Perfect — coverage looks good. Final call: ship tomorrow morning? react with :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown: and call out any last-second objections.

eva: :thumbsup: no objections from product if the two doc items are resolved.

liam: :thumbsup: will finish review by EOD.
anika: :thumbsup:
samir: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary reached 25% after 30m; no regressions observed.

maya: Great — proceeding with scheduled rollout tomorrow AM. If anything comes up, escalate to #oncall and ping me. Thanks team!
